name: simple-chicken-tacos
lines: Half a red onion, thinly sliced
1 cup thinly-sliced or shaved red cabbage
1 teaspoon kosher salt (Diamond brand; use less of others)

name: tomato-risotto-with-frizzled-red-onions
lines: 2 pounds (905 grams) large, ripe beefsteak tomatoes, halved
1 medium-large red onion, halved and thinly sliced
1 cup (200 grams) uncooked arborio or carnaroli, or another short-grained rice, such as sushi rice
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 to 3 tablespoons (30 to 45 grams) butter or olive oil, to finish
